note: Written BEFORE any LAB-08 code. Every clause of the LAB-08 tasks, guide 10.2 (mandatory controls), 10.3 (one economic engine), 11.1-11.2 (conclusion discipline), the acceptance requirements LAB-08 owns (T53, T58, T59, T60) and the phase outputs and exit gate. scripts/audit_lab08.py reads THIS file.
clauses: primary timeframes are frozen into the immutable study registry before any arm runs
model and data cohorts are frozen
compute budgets are frozen (guide 10.5 MATCHED_TOTAL_COMPUTE and OPERATIONAL_POLICY)
supplied presets appear ONLY as the retrospective USER_PRESET_REFERENCE control
any outer-window claim is qualified by the recorded contamination status
the freeze happens BEFORE the factorial runs, and is provably earlier
arms A, B, C and D share one engine
arms share identical costs: fee, slippage, funding treatment, exposure constraints
arms share the identical incumbent-retention rule
each arm pays the ACTUAL operational latency, never zero
a 2-cell pilot runs first for debugging, and is labelled as a pilot not a result
all 20 cell statuses are reported, including NOT_READY and insufficient-sample ones
no alpha is filtered out after its result is known; a low-trade alpha stays in the denominator
insufficient sample is REPORTED as such, never silently dropped or read as a zero
the registered contrasts are computed: B-A, C-A, D-B, D-C and the interaction (D-C)-(B-A)
arm E (selector + bank + response policy) is compared against arm B
arm E is compared against the BANK_CALENDAR control
the dynamic-refit arm is compared against a BUDGET-MATCHED calendar (CALENDAR_MATCHED)
RISK_ONLY isolates the exposure effect: same regime context, risk scaling only, params unchanged
STATE_PLACEBO labels have approximately the same dwell and switch frequency as the real states
the placebo is generated from development or known past ONLY; no future label is shuffled into the decision tape
DELAYED_STATE adds a registered delay and its transition sensitivity is read
EXPOST_DIAGNOSTIC hindsight labels are diagnostic only and never produce an eligible trade result
USER_PRESET_REFERENCE is labelled retrospective and is never a core outcome
no control is dropped because it beats the proposed method
controls are staged, not a full Cartesian product run at once
server-core is compared against server-derivatives and server-liquidity
the comparison is on COMPARABLE intervals, not each cohort's own longest window
every ablation trial is added to the experiment-search ledger
an improvement that comes from a short recent window is not attributed to a feature group
the ladder runs M0 then M1, with M1S and a limited M2 comparator declared built or deliberately unbuilt
K, lambda_jump, training memory and refit cadence are tuned in DEVELOPMENT only
not every combination is swept by default
each proposal states its question, its expected failure and its stop condition BEFORE it runs
cold and warm runtime are captured separately
compute waiting and activation delays are captured
CPU never exceeds the registered resource budget to let the dynamic policy finish first
exactly one confirmatory design is selected, or NO_PROMISING_DESIGN is declared
the selection reason is recorded and rests on DEVELOPMENT evidence
the tradeoffs of the selected design are recorded
the failure cases of the selected design are recorded
the uncertainty around the selection is recorded
no outer confirmation result is used to choose the design
alpha versions are frozen at selection
an optional alpha improvement is never folded into the winner silently
the whole phase runs in the DISCOVERY stage; the outer window is not consumed
the registered primary utility is the endpoint, not a more convenient statistic
the conclusion level comes from the registered vocabulary
a risk-only improvement is never recorded as a parameter-selection edge
each arm holds its own account with the SAME initial conditions
no arm's account resets at a fold or regime boundary
segments of unequal length are compared on the daily account, not by averaging fold Sharpes
A/B/C/D share fixed economics and budgets with no hidden fee, risk or evaluation advantage
RISK_ONLY and CALENDAR_MATCHED controls are present in the reported comparison
every negative, failed and pruned trial is retained with a correct null/status
the objective recomputed from its components matches the reported value under the numeric contract
regime feature and weight profiles are written
a registry of ALL attempted hypotheses is written
the phase ends with either a design freeze or NO_PROMISING_DESIGN
profit is NOT required to close discovery
a negative result is never relabelled a technical failure to justify a rerun
no arm was re-run after seeing its result in order to improve it
